label: ProductForge-Dashboard Backlog 58
title: Customer (tenant) admin UI: members/teams/roles/seats/billing
body:
## Original (as captured)
Per-tenant admin pages for users, teams, roles, seats, quotas, billing and license view.

## Context (from linked item product_forge:BI-0068)
Tenant-scoped APIs for a customer's own admin: invite/manage users + teams, assign roles (owner/admin, write, read-only), view seats/quotas, subscription/billing, and their license.
